excel.title: Excel import & export
excel.lead: Enter items, customers and opening stock in Excel instead of one by one, or keep a copy of them in Excel.
excel.step1: Download the list. It has everything already in Tula, so it is also the form to fill.
excel.step2: Add or change rows in Excel. Keep the headings in the first row as they are. Item codes and mobile numbers find the rows that already exist.
excel.step3: Choose the file here. Tula checks every row first and shows what it will add or change; nothing is saved until you press Save.
excel.ready: {{created}} to add, {{updated}} to change, {{skipped}} left as they are. Check the list, then save.
excel.hasErrors: {{count}} row(s) have mistakes. Nothing will be saved until they are fixed.
excel.fixAndRetry: Fix these rows in Excel, save the file, and choose it again.

sheet.NOT_XLSX: This is not an Excel workbook (.xlsx). In Excel, use Save As → Excel Workbook.
sheet.EMPTY: The first sheet has no rows under the headings.
sheet.TOO_MANY: At most 2000 rows at a time. Split the sheet into smaller files.

items.title: Items
items.about: Item code, names in English and Tamil, category, HSN, GST, units, rates and minimum stock.
help: Short code, letters, digits and - (TMT-12). An existing code changes that item; a new code adds one.
Category name. A new name adds the category.
Unit stock is kept in: KG, NOS, BAG, MTR…
Bigger units and how many base units make one: BDL=10; BOX=12. Use ~ for a theoretical weight: ROD~10.667.
Rate per base unit, in rupees. Leave empty for items on a daily rate.
For items priced by the day's rate (TMT). Leave empty for a fixed sale rate.
Added to the daily rate for this item, in rupees.
Yes or No (No for services and charges).

parties.title: Customers and suppliers
parties.about: Names, mobile numbers, GSTIN, credit terms and opening balances.
help: Customer, Supplier or Both. Empty means Customer.
Required. With no mobile number, the same name finds an existing row.
10 digits. The same number finds an existing customer.
15 characters. The state is taken from it.
2 digits (33 = Tamil Nadu), when there is no GSTIN. Empty means the state of the shop.
Rupees. 0 or empty for no limit.
Days allowed before a bill is overdue.
What they owed on the go-live date, in rupees; minus if you owed them. Empty keeps the balance as it is.

opening-stock.title: Opening stock
opening-stock.about: The stock counted on the go-live date and its cost, for every item that keeps stock.
help: Must be an item already in Tula (import items first).
In the base unit shown. Empty rows are left as they are.
Purchase cost per base unit, in rupees, before GST.
